//: Non-secret production defaults only. Secrets (Jwt:Secret, ConnectionStrings:Database/Redis, Email:*) and Cors:AllowedOrigins MUST come from the environment / a secret store — never commit them. Env-var form uses '__' for ':', e.g. Jwt__Secret, ConnectionStrings__Database, Cors__AllowedOrigins__0.
//background-jobs: Cadences below are tuned so the database stays idle when the app is unused (lets a serverless Postgres like Neon scale to zero). Outbox dispatch is signal-driven (immediate on write); the intervals here are only safety-net / housekeeping sweeps. Set any *Enabled to false to drop that periodic query entirely.
